name: Pocket Radio Repair
description: Disassemble a small assembled radio in the visible order, repair its exposed faults, rebuild the same parts and prove that it works.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Repair the pocket radio: select the matching tool, drag and rotate it on each fastener, lift covers in their visible order, clean dirty parts or replace missing parts from the tray, then rebuild every cover and fastener and press POWER TEST. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original pocket-radio transformation grounded in Assemble with Care's tool choice, ordered unscrewing, lifting, cleaning/replacement, reverse rebuild, and function-check mechanics. The visible state and independent replay share the generated part identities and access rules.
